name: Novel Catalyst Design and High-Throughput Screening
description: Concept of surface catalysis, surface structure, surface chemistry, catalyst synthesis, catalyst characterization, catalyst development, design principles governing structure-properties-performance, design principles of catalyst scaleup, impact of high throughput catalyst screening technologies, challenges of catalyst screening in high throughput experimentation, high throughput workflow development, integration of microreactor set-ups for high throughput screening, combinatorial approach for catalytic processes in oil refining and fine chemicals.
